systemOverview: VibeControl is an autonomous, local-first visual architecture and rolling-wave project control system. It maintains a dual-layer representation: a graph-based Single Source of Truth in `.project-control/` and an interactive local React Flow dashboard bridged via local Node.js APIs.

modules.name: Core State & Schema Engine
modules.description: Single-source-of-truth file reader, writer, and JSON/Zod schemas for .project-control graphs.
responsibilities: Parse and validate roadmap, architecture, state, codebase-map, canvas, and activity files
Ensure atomic read/write operations to avoid partial writes
Expose schema definitions for CLI and UI

modules.name: Integrity & Cross-Reference Validator
modules.description: Checks graph integrity, cross-referenced ID consistency, file existence, and architectural constraints.
responsibilities: Validate JSON schemas against Zod models
Verify referential integrity across milestones, modules, APIs, and tasks
Verify physical existence of files listed in codebase-map.json

modules.name: Agent Context Compiler
modules.description: Compiles tailored prompt context for coding agents based on active horizon tasks, architectural rules, and related APIs.
responsibilities: Assemble concise, high-signal system prompts for the active task
Filter relevant module and API contracts to stay within context windows
Emit ready-to-paste or piped context for AI coding assistants

modules.name: Local Bridge & REST Server
modules.description: Lightweight local HTTP/WebSocket server bridging the React Flow UI with the local filesystem .project-control repository.
responsibilities: Serve REST API endpoints for GET/POST /api/project-state
Broadcast file changes to connected UI clients

modules.name: Multi-Graph React Flow UI
modules.description: Visual workspace for viewing and editing roadmaps, architectural graphs, rolling waves, and ideation sticky notes.
responsibilities: Render React Flow canvas with custom node types
Provide interactive drag-and-drop node editing and edge linking
Persist canvas coordinates and state changes back to server

modules.name: Codebase Scanner & Drift Auditor
modules.description: Inspects repository filesystem, imports, and AST to update codebase-map.json and alert on architectural drift.
responsibilities: Scan project files and detect real module dependencies
Detect undeclared files and architectural boundary violations
Generate drift score and remediation recommendations

apis.name: Get Consolidated Project State
apis.description: Retrieves the complete state including roadmap, architecture, codebase map, state, canvas, and activity log.

apis.name: Update Project State Entity
apis.description: Updates graph entities, node positions, or task statuses, writes atomically to .project-control/ and appends to activity log.

apis.name: Compile Agent Prompt Context
apis.description: Generates a structured prompt context containing active task details, linked API contracts, architectural rules, and file roles.

apis.name: Complete Task & Advance Rolling Wave
apis.description: Marks active task as done, archives to completedWorkSummary, logs to activity.jsonl, and prepares next horizon task.

dataModels.name: Roadmap Model
dataModels.description: Macro milestones, status, dependencies, and deliverables.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: Milestone IDs this milestone depends on

dataModels.name: Architecture Model
dataModels.description: System modules, API endpoints, data models, and architectural rules.

dataModels.name: Codebase Map Model
dataModels.description: File and directory registry with role, layer, and linked architecture IDs.

dataModels.name: State Model
dataModels.description: Project summary, active milestone, completed tasks, and active horizon tasks.

dataModels.name: Canvas Model
dataModels.description: Visual coordinates, node layouts, and sticky note ideation for React Flow.

dataModels.name: Activity Log Model
dataModels.description: Append-only activity and audit log entries in activity.jsonl.

rules.title: Single Source of Truth in .project-control
rules.rule: All architectural decisions, APIs, and roadmap items must be recorded in .project-control JSON files before or concurrent with implementation.

rules.title: Strict Referential Integrity
rules.rule: Any milestoneId, moduleId, or apiId referenced in tasks, codebase-map, or canvas must correspond to an existing entity in roadmap or architecture.

rules.title: Rolling-Wave Active Horizon Limit
rules.rule: The active horizon tasks in state.json must strictly contain between 1 and 3 concrete tasks (max 5) to prevent cognitive overload and stale backlog debt.

rules.title: Codebase Map Completeness
rules.rule: Every repository source and script file must have a registered entry in codebase-map.json detailing its role, layer, and linked module.

rules.title: Append-Only Activity Log
rules.rule: activity.jsonl must strictly be appended to; historical entries must not be mutated or deleted to preserve auditability.
